כָּל־הַיָּמִים → as long jointly expresses the full duration: כֹּל supplies its extent, יוֹם its time, and the article determines the days specified by the following clause. No non-arbitrary allocation divides as from long among those morphemes; retain the duration core as noncompositional, headed on long with the first source token as display anchor (rules 2 and 6). The temporal determination stays inside the fusion under rule 30; the explicit relative has its own closing as and is separate.

אֲשֶׁר introduces the clause defining the duration and independently owns the closing as of as long as (rules 2 and 11). Removing that as removes the relative link, whereas as long expresses the duration core; a four-morpheme fusion would absorb this separately recoverable contribution.
